prelaunch_seal_requirement: Before the first provider call, an outcome-blind sequential pull/inspect pass must atomically bind each exact tag to its RepoDigest, local image ID, and linux/amd64 platform. A tag absent before this pass is removed only by exact tag after its identity is sealed; a preexisting or ownership-uncertain image is retained.
case_window_requirement: For each Case pair, ExactImageLease must persist intent before pulling an absent tag, require the local RepoDigest/image ID/platform to equal the prelaunch expected identity, serve both adjacent candidate slots, and remove only a campaign-owned newly-pulled exact tag after both artifacts are sealed.
claim: Image identity is evaluation infrastructure; it does not expose or pre-judge correctness.
